item.title: The Social Contractors: Return To Rock Spancky's Bar! — Fri Jul 31, 9:00 PM — Spancky's Bar
item.description:
*….Get ready for the super-entertaining sounds of local band The Social Contractors. They totally rock, in all the right ways…”* - Argus-Courier, 2025
The Social Contractors return to rock Spancky's Bar from 9 PM until midnight with their upbeat blend of original rock and tasteful interpretations of classic 60-90s hits from the bands you know and love (Beatles, Hendrix, Pink Floyd, Cream, Stevie Wonder, Steve Miller, Foreigner, Police, Men At Work, Steely Dan, Tom Petty, Tears For Fears, U2, and more).
Whether you like melodic vocals, searing guitar and sax solos, intriguing lyrics, captivating songs, or just great dynamic and danceable rhythms, The Social Contractors won't disappoint.
The Social Contractors lineup for this free live performance features band founder and songwriter, Jason E Davies (lead vocals/lead guitar), Travis Thayer (sax/keys/vocals), Rob Neidel (bass/vocals), and Chris (drums).
Source: Press Democrat

item.description:
**Art Nite / Noche del Arte Healdsburg Returns August 6 with “Music and Mocktails”**
Healdsburg Comes Alive with Art, Live Performances, and Creative Sips
Healdsburg, CA — On Thursday, August 6, Healdsburg’s monthly Art Nite returns from 5–7 p.m. with this month's theme: Music and Mocktails!Downtown galleries, venues, and pop-ups will open their doors for an evening of art, community, and celebration. Local shops, wineries, and restaurants will offer special perks throughout the evening, showcasing Healdsburg’s creative spirit. Art Nite is a free, first-Thursday tradition in Healdsburg running from April through December.
This month’s event will spotlight an exciting lineup of performing artists, including:Marcos Pereda, John Youngblood, Troubleshootin', Olive Munden, Brazilian Jazz (Jobim), Flute Fusion Duo, and The Magnolias.Guests can also enjoy handcrafted mocktails provided by Land and Local, adding a fresh and festive touch to the art-filled stroll through town.

item.title: Marin Farmers Markets — Thu Aug 27, 8:00 AM — Marin Veterans' Memorial Auditorium
item.description:
Price: Free
Sponsor: Marin Center
Explore the bounty of summer at the Marin Farmers Markets. Taste vine-ripened tomatoes, corn that was picked that morning, and peaches so juicy you have to bend over just to get a bite. Farm-fresh eggs, grass-fed beef, artisan c heeses, raw milk, and freshly baked breads complete the shopping exper ience. Specialty prepared foods and handmade art add to the magic of the market.
Enjoy the intimate feeling of the Thursday Marin Farmers Market, an ideal place to meet for lunch and pick up fresh produce for the weekend. Discover the abundance and diversity of product at the celebrated Sunday Marin Farmers Market, the third largest farmers market in California. Turn your dollar into a vote for local sustainable agriculture, shrink your eco-footprint, and revive the feeling of being intimate ly connected to your food by meeting your farmers face-to-face. The market takes place rain or shine.
www.aginstitutemarin.org
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:
Seasonal Offering Through September 2026
Explore a new dimension of Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc through this seasonal tasting experience. Begin with a glass of the 2025 Yountville Sauvignon Blanc as you’re guided through the cellar, exploring the cigar, puncheon, and barrique barrels used in our Reserve program.
Then, take a seat in our vineyard‑facing salon for a guided exploration of the 2023, 2024, and 2025 Yountville Sauvignon Blanc. Your tasting will conclude with our Reserve Sauvignon Blanc, offering a deeper look at the craft and progression behind this signature wine.
*Tasting fees are applied toward wine purchases.*

item.title: A Taste of Italy at Centennial Mountain Tasting Room — Thu Aug 27, 11:00 AM — Centennial Mountain Tasting Room
item.description:
For wine drinkers eager to experience world-class wines made in California from Italian varieties, the Centennial Mountain Tasting Room is a must during any trip to Sonoma County. Located just off the plaza in the charming town of Healdsburg near famed restaurants, boutiques and galleries, the Centennial Mountain Tasting Room is a destination that invites discovery. Founded by the acclaimed team that guides renowned Pinot Noir and Chardonnay producer Rhys Vineyards, Centennial Mountain was established to explore Italian grape varieties grown on its acclaimed Centennial Mountain Vineyard in the rugged mountains of Northern Sonoma County.
The Centennial Mountain Vineyard Tasting features the winery’s coveted Nebbiolo, and the pioneering Carricante and Nerello Mascalese wines, among others. To showcase how beautifully the wines pair with food, the winery also offers a delicious Wine and Sushi Pairing from nearby Asahi Sushi, one of Healdsburg’s most popular dining destinations.

item.title: The Brandlin Estate Wine & Food Tasting Experience — Thu Aug 27, 11:00 AM — Brandlin Estate
item.description:
Born on the rugged slopes of Mount Veeder, Brandlin Estate produces wines of structure, intensity, and place. The Brandlin Experience offers an in-depth exploration of this historic vineyard site through a curated tasting of five estate-grown wines—including Zinfandel from century-old vines and the estate’s signature Cabernet Sauvignon. This seated, guided experience invites guests to delve into the mountain terroir through the lens of small-lot winemaking. Each wine reflects the elevation, exposure, and rocky soils that define the Brandlin Estate. For an added dimension, guests may opt to include seasonal bites, thoughtfully paired to complement the structure and complexity of the wines. This experience is hosted at the picturesque Boathouse.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Summer Collectors Lunch Pairing at Lynmar Estate — Thu Aug 27, 12:30 PM — Lynmar Estate
item.description:
Rooted in the bounty of Quail Hill Vineyard, Lynmar Estate’s Summer Collectors Lunch Pairing invites guests to experience the flavors of Sonoma County at their seasonal peak. Get ready to feel the rhythm and energy of Rio de Janeiro! Samba no Pé \(Samba in the Foot\) is the captivating solo style of samba danced in the streets and at Carnival, known for its rapid, intricate footwork and infectious hip movements.
You will learn
The Basic Step: You will master the signature quick-quick-slow rhythm that defines Samba no Pé.
Arm & Hip Styling: You will learn how to add the authentic flair, movement, and energy that makes Brazilian samba so captivating.
Technique & Posture: You will receive tips on proper body alignment to help you dance longer, faster, and more safely.
Rhythm & Musicality: You will learn how to connect your movement directly to the irresistible beat of the bateria \(the samba drum section\).
This class is perfect for anyone looking to connect with the vibrant spirit of Brazil, improve coordination, and get a fantastic workout—all while learning the foundational steps of this iconic dance. No partner or prior dance experience is required!
